node.title: Almost-all-primes collision-lightness (the density partial)
node.statement: Sum over the bounded-height norm family: Sum_p #collisions(p) <= Sum_pairs Omega(Norm(diff)) <= #pairs * log(height). Hence in ANY dyadic prime range, all but a poly-sized exceptional set of primes have collision-light e1 value sets. Partial (the official p could be exceptional) but dossier-grade.
